title: Hans Melo Presents at Bio-Europe 2024 in Stockholm
summary: Menten AI's CEO, Dr. Hans Melo, will be sharing the latest developments at Menten AI in Stockholm on adding drug-like properties including plasma stability and membrane-permeability.
body_markdown:
#### [Bio-Europe 2024 Stockholm - Nov. 3-6](https://informaconnect.com/bioeurope/)


‍


##### **Peptide Showcase: Menten AI, Inc.**


Menten AI's CEO,[Dr. Hans Melo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hansmelo/) , will be sharing the latest developments of[Menten AI's generative AI platform](https://www.linkedin.com/company/menten-ai/) in Stockholm including multi-parameter design of membrane permeable peptides.
